# Money Tree Leads

> AI-powered lead engine for Canadian realtors. An AI assistant calls each enquiry from ad campaigns and scores the conversation 0–100 on timeline, budget, and motivation. Each lead goes to one agent, with the summary, transcript, and recording. Four plans, $179–$1,199/month USD, cancel any time.

Money Tree Leads (legal entity: Money Tree Conversions, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada) sells exclusive real estate leads to agents in Canada.

## Key facts

- Audience: real estate agents and realtors in Canada
- Lead source: ad campaigns and enquiry forms, with consent to be contacted
- Qualification: an AI assistant phones during business hours, tries up to 3 times over about two days, and may follow up by text; calls are recorded
- Score: 0–100 from the conversation (hot 70+, warm 40–69, cool under 40). A lead nobody could reach is marked cold and only appears in the lead feed
- Exclusivity: each lead goes to one agent, matched by service area, price range, and language; higher plans get priority
- What the agent receives: name, phone, email, language, area, AI summary, score, call transcript, and recording
- Lead volume: no set number of leads per month is promised; delivery depends on the enquiries that come in
- Also included: an AI phone assistant on the agent's own number, and a calendar
- Pricing: Bronze $179/month (pay per lead), Silver $499/month + $250 setup, Gold $699/month + $200 setup, Platinum $1,199/month; all USD
- Cancellation: cancel any time
- Sign up: https://app.moneytreeleads.ca/sign-up
- Log in: https://app.moneytreeleads.ca/sign-in

## How it differs from portal leads

Leads bought from real estate portals are often form submissions shared between several agents. With Money Tree Leads, an AI assistant speaks with the person first and each lead goes to one agent.
